scope: Fresh live mechanics frontier after Batch 488; eight genuinely under-detailed records were selected after correcting the audit-registry filename normalization.

selected.name: God of Destruction's Roar
selected.finding: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ105; sustained shout drains Stamina, forces guarding while Stamina remains, and exhausts the user if held too long.

selected.name: God of Destruction's Menace
selected.finding: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ105; four initial Ki spheres can be followed by additional tracking volleys, with current documentation reporting 26 hits and about 30% total damage.
selected.change: Expanded multi-input tracking sequence and bounded output.

selected.name: Hero's Flute
selected.finding: 100-Ki protective Super from PQ116; barrier protects against melee and Ki Blast attacks for 7.5 seconds while ally assist effects remain usable.
selected.change: Expanded barrier scope, duration, and support use.

selected.name: Beast
selected.finding: 500-Ki Awoken for all CaCs; +30% all attack, +20% Ki restoration, +20% damage taken, combo/teleport alterations, and 500-Ki activation.
selected.change: Expanded transformation modifiers and activation/combo behavior.

selected.name: Rakshasa's Claw
selected.finding: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ57; steerable sword-wave sequence reaches five ranged hits before a teleporting overhead slash, six hits total and about 20% damage.
selected.change: Expanded input, trajectory, sequence, and bounded output.

selected.name: Reverse Mabakusenko
selected.finding: 300-Ki counter Ultimate; counter stance triggers an arm swipe into an energy wave, with dedicated evidence reporting 19 hits and about 30% total damage.
selected.change: Expanded counter trigger and source-reported output while preserving short-range uncertainty.

selected.name: Indomitable
selected.finding: Charge skill restores both Ki and Stamina. Current player evidence reports slow normal-health Ki charging and a Burst Charge-like change below 50% health while Stamina restoration continues.
selected.change: Expanded dual-resource and health-threshold behavior as explicitly player-reported evidence.

selected.name: Body Change
selected.finding: 300-Ki Other Ultimate learned from Ginyu Lesson 3; attempts a body swap and is documented as 1-on-1-only, with current Xenoverse 2 evidence excluding PQs, Raids, and Extra Missions.
selected.change: Expanded mode restrictions and acquisition boundary.

sources_policy: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence prioritized. Source-reported numbers and player observations remain bounded; unsupported exact frames, universal scaling, and hidden probabilities are not inferred.
canonical_sync: Eight records synchronized into docs/data/skills.json and docs/data/skills-index.json.
